task.title: How to Upgrade an Organization Subscription
task.shortdesc: How organization administrators can increase the number of available seats for a paid subscription.

prereq.p: You must have the Organization Administrator role in your organization.

context.p: Use this procedure for an active paid subscription with Verifone account information.

step.cmd: Click Upgrade plan in the subscription status and actions section.
In the Upgrade Subscription dialog box, review the current plan and seat allocation.
Choose a plan and enter the number of Author and SME seats. Each value must be equal to or greater than the current allocation.

info.note: You can move to a higher plan or increase the number of seats, but you cannot downgrade a subscription or decrease the number of available seats.

step.stepresult: A new browser tab opens and redirects you to the Verifone payment system.

step.cmd: Complete the upgrade purchase in the Verifone payment system.
After the confirmation page appears, close the upgrade tab and return to the subscription page.
Wait up to 10 minutes for the upgrade to be processed, then refresh the page to check the updated seat allocation.

postreq.note: After you complete the upgrade, allow up to 10 minutes for Verifone to send the license change notification to .
